title: Frailty Indices and Preoperative Clinical Factors for Predicting Myocardial Injury After Non-Cardiac Surgery (MINS) in High-Risk Geriatric Orthopedic Patients: A Machine-Learning Study.
summary: Frailty indices were assessed alongside clinical factors for myocardial injury after non-cardiac surgery in 656 high-risk geriatric orthopedic patients. Holdout testing found no significant incremental value from mFI-5 or mFI-11, and no model significantly surpassed RCRI; the negative result itself is the clinical prediction finding. The result is reported in the Journal of Clinical Medicine. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Retrospective single-center cohort, 656 patients aged 65+, 82 MINS events. Several models with 30% holdout
